input.query: WITH m AS (SELECT a.month, SUM(a.card_spend_eur)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active),0) spend_per_active, SUM(a.n_card_txns)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active),0) txns_per_active FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' GROUP BY a.month) SELECT AVG(spend_per_active) FILTER (WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-03-01') AS baseline_mean_jan25_feb26, STDDEV_SAMP(spend_per_active) FILTER (WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-03-01') AS baseline_sd, MAX(spend_per_active) FILTER (WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-03-01') AS baseline_max, AVG(txns_per_active) FILTER (WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-03-01') AS txns_baseline, MAX(txns_per_active) FILTER (WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-03-01') AS txns_baseline_max, MAX(spend_per_active) FILTER (WHERE month=DATE '2026-03-01') AS march_spend, MAX(spend_per_active) FILTER (WHERE month=DATE '2026-05-01') AS may_spend, MAX(txns_per_active) FILTER (WHERE month=DATE '2026-03-01') AS march_txns, MAX(txns_per_active) FILTER (WHERE month=DATE '2026-05-01') AS may_txns FROM m
